newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ABS revises down Australia trade deficit data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ABS revises down Australia trade deficit data.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) said on Monday substantial net credit provisions to the estimated balance on goods and services reduced the deficit reported for the six months to December 1996 by A$483 million.
The bureau said the deficit for the 1995/96 year (July-June) had been reduced by A$1.15 billion, for 1994/95 by A$918 million and for 1993/94 by A$590 million.
For the period from 1985 to December 1996, the deficit has been revised down by a total A$5.2 billion.
